af.text: God het die wêreld so liefgehad dat Hy sy enigste Seun gegee het.

en.title: An Angel Visits Mary
story: Now our trail goes back in time, to see how Jesus’ adventure on earth began.

In a little town called Nazareth lived a young woman named Mary. She was going to marry a carpenter named Joseph. She was not rich or famous. But one day an angel named Gabriel appeared to her! ‘Greetings! The Lord is with you,’ he said.

Mary was scared. ‘Don’t be afraid, Mary,’ said Gabriel. ‘God is pleased with you. You are going to have a baby boy, and you will call him Jesus. He will be the Son of God, and his kingdom will never end!’

‘How can this happen?’ Mary asked. ‘The Holy Spirit will make it happen,’ said the angel. ‘Nothing is impossible with God.’ And Mary said, ‘I am the Lord’s servant. Let it happen just as you said.’ Mary said YES to God.

verse.text: I am the Lord’s servant. Let it happen to me as you have said.

lessons: God chooses ordinary people for his big plans.
Mary said yes to God, even though she didn’t understand everything.
Nothing is impossible with God.
questions: How do you think Mary felt when she saw the angel?
How can you say ‘yes’ to God?
prayer: thank you that you choose ordinary people like me.
I say yes to you. Amen.

mission.text: Say ‘Yes, Mom!’ happily the first time tomorrow. It is practice for saying yes to God.

af.title: ’n Engel Besoek Maria
story: Nou gaan ons pad terug in die tyd, om te sien hoe Jesus se avontuur op aarde begin het.

In ’n klein dorpie met die naam Nasaret het ’n jong vrou met die naam Maria gewoon. Sy sou trou met ’n timmerman met die naam Josef. Sy was nie ryk of beroemd nie. Maar eendag het ’n engel met die naam Gabriël aan haar verskyn! ‘Groete! Die Here is met jou,’ het hy gesê.

Maria was bang. ‘Moenie bang wees nie, Maria,’ sê Gabriël. ‘God is bly oor jou. Jy gaan ’n seuntjie kry, en jy moet Hom Jesus noem. Hy sal die Seun van God wees, en sy koninkryk sal nooit eindig nie!’

‘Hoe kan dit gebeur?’ vra Maria. ‘Die Heilige Gees sal dit laat gebeur,’ sê die engel. ‘Niks is vir God onmoontlik nie.’ En Maria het gesê: ‘Ek is die dienares van die Here. Laat dit met my gebeur soos u gesê het.’ Maria het JA gesê vir God.

verse.text: Ek is die dienares van die Here. Laat dit met my gebeur soos u gesê het.

lessons: God kies gewone mense vir sy groot planne.
Maria het ja gesê vir God, al het sy nie alles verstaan nie.
Niks is vir God onmoontlik nie.
questions: Hoe dink jy het Maria gevoel toe sy die engel sien?
Hoe kan jy ‘ja’ sê vir God?
prayer: dankie dat U gewone mense soos ek kies.
sê ek ja vir U. Amen.

mission.text: Sê môre die eerste keer bly ‘Ja, Mamma!’ Dit is oefening om ja te sê vir God.

en.title: Joseph's Dream
story: When Joseph heard that Mary was going to have a baby, he was confused and worried. What should he do?

One night, while Joseph was sleeping, an angel appeared to him in a dream. ‘Joseph, don’t be afraid to take Mary as your wife. The baby inside her is from the Holy Spirit. She will have a son, and you are to name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.’
Remember Isaiah’s clue? The angel said this was exactly what God had promised: ‘They will call him Immanuel,’ which means ‘God with us.’

When Joseph woke up, he did exactly what the angel said. He married Mary and got ready to look after God’s Son. God was coming to be with his people: not far away up in the sky, but right here, as one of us!

verse.text: They will call him Immanuel, which means ‘God with us.’

lessons: Jesus is God, who came to be with us.
The name Jesus means ‘God saves’.
Joseph obeyed God straight away.
questions: What does ‘God with us’ mean for you tonight?
How did Joseph obey God?
prayer: thank you for coming to be with us in Jesus.
You are with me right now,

mission.text: Count how many times you hear the name ‘Jesus’ in Christmas songs tomorrow.

af.title: Josef se Droom
story: Toe Josef hoor dat Maria ’n baba gaan kry, was hy deurmekaar en bekommerd. Wat moes hy doen?

Een nag, terwyl Josef slaap, het ’n engel in ’n droom aan hom verskyn. ‘Josef, moenie bang wees om Maria as jou vrou te neem nie. Die baba in haar is van die Heilige Gees. Sy sal ’n seun hê, en jy moet Hom Jesus noem, want Hy sal sy mense van hulle sondes red.’
Onthou jy Jesaja se leidraad? Die engel het gesê dit is presies wat God belowe het: ‘Hulle sal Hom Immanuel noem,’ wat beteken ‘God met ons’.

Toe Josef wakker word, het hy presies gedoen wat die engel gesê het. Hy het met Maria getrou en gereed gemaak om na God se Seun te kyk. God het gekom om by sy mense te wees: nie ver weg bo in die lug nie, maar reg hier, as een van ons!

verse.text: Hulle sal Hom Immanuel noem, wat beteken ‘God met ons’.

lessons: Jesus is God wat gekom het om by ons te wees.
Die naam Jesus beteken ‘God red’.
Josef het God dadelik gehoorsaam.
questions: Wat beteken ‘God met ons’ vir jou vanaand?
Hoe het Josef God gehoorsaam?
prayer: dankie dat U in Jesus gekom het om by ons te wees.

mission.text: Tel môre hoeveel keer jy die naam ‘Jesus’ in Kersliedjies hoor.

en.title: The Long Trip to Bethlehem
story: The Roman emperor, Caesar Augustus, made a law: ‘Everyone must go to their family’s hometown to be counted!’ Joseph’s family came from Bethlehem, the town of King David.

So Joseph and Mary packed up and set off. It was a long, long trip, about as far as driving for two hours, but they had to walk! Over hills and dusty roads it went. Mary was about to have her baby. It took many days.

Why does this matter? Remember the clue from the prophet Micah, hundreds of years before? He said the Rescuer would be born in Bethlehem! Mary lived in Nazareth, far away. But God used an emperor’s law to bring Mary to exactly the right town at exactly the right time.
God takes care of every tiny detail. He is never late, and his promises always come true.

verse.text: But you, Bethlehem… out of you will come a ruler.

lessons: God is faithful. His promises come true right down to the details.
God is in charge, even of kings and emperors.
Long, hard journeys are easier when God is with us.
questions: What is the longest trip you have been on?
What little details of your life does God care about?
prayer: you take care of every little detail.

mission.text: Set out a nativity set (or draw one). Put Mary and Joseph far from the stable and move them a little closer each night.

af.title: Die Lang Reis na Betlehem
story: Die Romeinse keiser, Augustus, het ’n wet gemaak: ‘Almal moet na hulle familie se tuisdorp gaan om getel te word!’ Josef se familie het van Betlehem gekom, die dorp van koning Dawid.

Toe pak Josef en Maria op en vertrek. Dit was ’n lang, lang reis, omtrent so ver soos twee uur se ry met ’n motor, maar hulle moes loop! Oor heuwels en stowwerige paaie. Maria was amper gereed om haar baba te kry. Dit het baie dae gevat.

Hoekom is dit belangrik? Onthou die leidraad van die profeet Miga, honderde jare tevore? Hy het gesê die Redder sal in Betlehem gebore word! Maria het in Nasaret gewoon, ver weg. Maar God het ’n keiser se wet gebruik om Maria op presies die regte tyd na presies die regte dorp te bring.
God sorg vir elke klein detail. Hy is nooit laat nie, en sy beloftes word altyd waar.

verse.text: Maar jy, Betlehem… uit jou sal ’n heerser kom.

lessons: God is getrou. Sy beloftes word waar, tot in die kleinste detail.
God is in beheer, selfs oor konings en keisers.
Lang, moeilike reise is makliker as God by ons is.
questions: Wat is die langste reis wat jy al gemaak het?
Watter klein detailjies in jou lewe gee God om oor?
prayer: U sorg vir elke klein detail.

mission.text: Pak ’n Kerskrip uit (of teken een). Sit Maria en Josef ver van die stal af en skuif hulle elke aand ’n bietjie nader.

en.title: No Room!
story: When Mary and Joseph finally arrived in Bethlehem, the town was packed with people. Knock, knock. ‘Sorry, no room!’ Knock, knock. ‘Full up!’ There was nowhere to stay, and Mary’s baby was coming soon.

At last they found a place where animals were kept. It wasn’t a palace. It was probably smelly, with straw on the floor, a donkey and maybe some cows and sheep. And there, that very night, baby Jesus was born!
Mary wrapped him snugly in strips of cloth and laid him in a manger, a feeding box for animals.

Think about this: Jesus is the King of the whole universe. He made the stars and the oceans! But he didn’t come with a crown and a castle. He came as a tiny baby in a stable. That is called being humble. Jesus came small so that everyone, rich or poor, could come close to him.

verse.text: She wrapped him in cloths and laid him in a manger, because there was no room for them.

lessons: Jesus, the King of everything, came as a small baby.
Jesus is humble, and he came for everyone.
We can make room in our hearts for Jesus.
questions: If Jesus came to our house, where would you want him to sleep?
How can we make room for Jesus in our hearts?
prayer: you came as a little baby
There is always room for you in my heart. Amen.

mission.text: Do one helpful job tomorrow without being asked, like clearing the table or packing away.

af.title: Geen Plek Nie!
story: Toe Maria en Josef eindelik in Betlehem aankom, was die dorp stampvol mense. Klop, klop. ‘Jammer, geen plek nie!’ Klop, klop. ‘Ons is vol!’ Daar was nêrens om te bly nie, en Maria se baba sou nou-nou kom.

Uiteindelik het hulle ’n plek gekry waar diere gehou is. Dit was nie ’n paleis nie. Dit het seker gestink, met strooi op die vloer, ’n donkie en dalk ’n paar koeie en skape. En daar, daardie selfde nag, is baba Jesus gebore!
Maria het Hom styf in doeke toegedraai en Hom in ’n krip neergelê, ’n voerbak vir diere.

Dink hieraan: Jesus is die Koning van die hele heelal. Hy het die sterre en die oseane gemaak! Maar Hy het nie met ’n kroon en ’n kasteel gekom nie. Hy het as ’n klein babatjie in ’n stal gekom. Dit noem ons nederig. Jesus het klein gekom sodat almal, ryk of arm, naby aan Hom kon kom.

verse.text: Sy het Hom in doeke toegedraai en in ’n krip neergelê, omdat daar vir hulle geen plek was nie.

lessons: Jesus, die Koning van alles, het as ’n klein baba gekom.
Jesus is nederig, en Hy het vir almal gekom.
Ons kan plek maak in ons harte vir Jesus.
questions: As Jesus na ons huis toe kom, waar sou jy wou hê moet Hy slaap?
Hoe kan ons plek maak vir Jesus in ons harte?
prayer: U het as ’n klein babatjie gekom
Daar is altyd plek vir U in my hart. Amen.

mission.text: Doen môre een hulpvaardige werkie sonder dat iemand vra, soos die tafel afdek of wegpak.

en.title: Angels in the Night Sky
story: Out in the fields near Bethlehem, some shepherds were watching their sheep in the dark. It was a quiet, ordinary night. Then suddenly, FLASH! An angel appeared, and God’s glory shone all around them! The shepherds were terrified.

‘Don’t be afraid!’ said the angel. ‘I bring you good news of great joy for all people! Today in Bethlehem a Saviour has been born. He is Christ the Lord! You will find the baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.’
Then the whole sky filled with angels, more than you could count, singing: ‘Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth!’
The shepherds ran to Bethlehem and found baby Jesus, just as the angel had said. Then they told everyone they met! God told the good news first to ordinary shepherds, because Jesus came for everyone.

verse.text: I bring you good news that will bring great joy for all the people.

lessons: The good news of Jesus is for everyone.
God’s news brings great joy.
When we meet Jesus, we want to tell others.
questions: What would you do if you saw a sky full of angels?
Who can we tell the good news to?
prayer: thank you for the good news of Jesus!
and help me tell others. Amen.

mission.text: Sing a Christmas song for someone tomorrow.

af.title: Engele in die Naghemel
story: In die veld naby Betlehem het ’n paar skaapwagters in die donker na hulle skape gekyk. Dit was ’n stil, gewone nag. Toe skielik, FLITS! ’n Engel het verskyn, en God se heerlikheid het rondom hulle geskyn! Die skaapwagters was doodbang.

‘Moenie bang wees nie!’ het die engel gesê. ‘Ek bring vir julle goeie nuus wat groot vreugde vir almal sal wees! Vandag is in Betlehem vir julle ’n Verlosser gebore. Hy is Christus die Here! Julle sal die baba in doeke toegedraai in ’n krip vind.’
Toe was die hele hemel skielik vol engele, meer as wat jy kan tel, en hulle het gesing: ‘Eer aan God in die hoogste hemel, en vrede op aarde!’

Die skaapwagters het na Betlehem gehardloop en baba Jesus gevind, net soos die engel gesê het. Toe vertel hulle almal wat hulle teëkom! God het die goeie nuus eerste aan gewone skaapwagters vertel, want Jesus het vir almal gekom.

verse.text: Ek bring vir julle goeie nuus wat groot vreugde sal wees vir al die mense.

lessons: Die goeie nuus van Jesus is vir almal.
God se nuus bring groot vreugde.
As ons Jesus ontmoet, wil ons ander vertel.
questions: Wat sou jy doen as jy ’n hemel vol engele sien?
Vir wie kan ons die goeie nuus vertel?
prayer: dankie vir die goeie nuus van Jesus!
en help my om ander te vertel. Amen.

mission.text: Sing môre ’n Kersliedjie vir iemand.

en.title: Follow the Star!
story: Far away in the east, some wise men studied the stars. One night they saw a brand-new, extra-bright star. ‘A new king has been born!’ they said. ‘Let’s go and worship him!’

So they packed their camels with treasure and set off on a long adventure, following the star across deserts and mountains. They went to King Herod’s palace in Jerusalem first, asking, ‘Where is the baby who was born to be king?’ (Herod wasn’t happy about another king at all!) The teachers looked in God’s Word and said, ‘Bethlehem!’

The star went ahead of them and stopped right over the house where Jesus was. The wise men were filled with joy! They bowed down and worshipped Jesus, and gave him gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.
They searched for Jesus, and God led them all the way to him.

verse.text: You will look for me and find me when you look for me with all your heart.

lessons: God leads people who are searching for him.
Jesus is worth a long journey to find.
We can give Jesus our best gift: our hearts.
questions: What gift would you give baby Jesus?
How does God lead us to him today? (The Bible, church, Mom and Dad.)
prayer: thank you for leading me to Jesus.
I give him my best gift:

mission.text: Make or wrap a little gift for someone in your family.

af.title: Volg die Ster!
story: Ver in die ooste het ’n paar wyse manne die sterre bestudeer. Een nag sien hulle ’n splinternuwe, ekstra helder ster. ‘’n Nuwe koning is gebore!’ het hulle gesê. ‘Kom ons gaan aanbid Hom!’

Toe laai hulle hul kamele vol skatte en vertrek op ’n lang avontuur, en volg die ster oor woestyne en berge. Eers het hulle na koning Herodes se paleis in Jerusalem gegaan en gevra: ‘Waar is die baba wat gebore is om koning te wees?’ (Herodes was glad nie bly oor nog ’n koning nie!) Die leermeesters het in God se Woord gekyk en gesê: ‘Betlehem!’
Die ster het voor hulle uit gegaan en reg bo die huis waar Jesus was, gaan staan. Die wyse manne was vol vreugde! Hulle het gebuig en Jesus aanbid, en Hom geskenke van goud, wierook en mirre gegee.
Hulle het na Jesus gesoek, en God het hulle die hele pad na Hom toe gelei.

verse.text: Julle sal My soek en vind as julle My met julle hele hart soek.

lessons: God lei mense wat na Hom soek.
Jesus is ’n lang reis werd om te vind.
Ons kan Jesus ons beste geskenk gee: ons harte.
questions: Watter geskenk sou jy vir baba Jesus gee?
Hoe lei God ons vandag na Hom toe? (Die Bybel, die kerk, Mamma en Pappa.)
prayer: dankie dat U my na Jesus lei.
Ek gee Hom my beste geskenk:

mission.text: Maak of draai ’n klein geskenkie toe vir iemand in jou familie.

en.title: The Best Present Ever
story: Tomorrow is Christmas! Can you feel the excitement? Presents under the tree, yummy food, family together.
But why do we give presents at Christmas? Because God gave the very first and very best Christmas present: Jesus!

Do you remember Adam and Eve hiding in the garden? Sin (the wrong things we do) puts a wall between us and God. We can’t climb over that wall on our own. So God, who loves us so much, sent Jesus to break down the wall and bring us back to him. That is why the angel said, ‘A Saviour has been born!’ A saviour is a rescuer.
God didn’t send Jesus because we were good enough. He sent him because he loves us. Not just a little, but SO much. The Bible says, ‘God is love.’ Love is what God is like, all the way through.

verse.text: God loved the world so much that he gave his one and only Son.

af.title: Die Beste Geskenk Ooit
story: Môre is dit Kersfees! Kan jy die opwinding voel? Geskenke onder die boom, lekker kos, familie bymekaar.
Maar hoekom gee ons geskenke met Kersfees? Omdat God die heel eerste en heel beste Kersgeskenk gegee het: Jesus!

Onthou jy hoe Adam en Eva in die tuin weggekruip het? Sonde (die verkeerde dinge wat ons doen) sit ’n muur tussen ons en God. Ons kan nie self oor daardie muur klim nie. Toe het God, wat ons so liefhet, Jesus gestuur om die muur af te breek en ons terug te bring na Hom toe, sodat ons weer sy kinders kan wees. Dit is hoekom die engel gesê het: ‘’n Verlosser is gebore!’ ’n Verlosser is ’n Redder.

God het Jesus nie gestuur omdat ons goed genoeg was nie. Hy het Hom gestuur omdat Hy ons liefhet. Nie net ’n bietjie nie, maar SO baie. Die Bybel sê: ‘God is liefde.’ Liefde is hoe God is, heeltemal deur en deur.

verse.text: God het die wêreld so liefgehad dat Hy sy enigste Seun gegee het.

lessons: Jesus is God se geskenk aan ons.
God het Jesus gestuur omdat Hy ons so baie liefhet.
Jesus het gekom om ons te red en terug te bring na God toe.
questions: Wat is die beste geskenk wat jy nog ooit gekry het?
Hoe is Jesus ’n selfs beter geskenk?
prayer: dankie vir die beste geskenk ooit: Jesus!
Dankie dat U my so baie liefhet.
Ek is ook lief vir U. Amen.

mission.text: Sing môre, voor jy geskenke oopmaak, ‘Veels geluk’ vir Jesus.

en.title: The Best Present Ever
story: Tomorrow is Christmas! Can you feel the excitement? Presents under the tree, yummy food, family together.
But why do we give presents at Christmas? Because God gave the very first and very best Christmas present: Jesus!

Do you remember Adam and Eve hiding in the garden? Sin (the wrong things we do) puts a wall between us and God. We can’t climb over that wall on our own. So God, who loves us so much, sent Jesus to break down the wall and bring us back to him. That is why the angel said, ‘A Saviour has been born!’ A saviour is a rescuer.
God didn’t send Jesus because we were good enough. He sent him because he loves us. Not just a little, but SO much. The Bible says, ‘God is love.’ Love is what God is like, all the way through.

en.fact: John 3:16 has been translated into thousands of languages, so people all over the world can read it.
en.deeper: God gave Jesus because he loves us, not because we earned it. Why is that such good news?
en.journal: Write John 3:16, but put your own name where it says ‘the world’.

en.title: Christmas Campfire: Happy Birthday, Jesus!
story: Merry Christmas, explorer! Today we celebrate the birthday of Jesus. Remember the promise God made in the garden, the clues he gave Isaiah and Micah, the angel’s visit to Mary, the long trip to Bethlehem and the baby in the manger? Every promise came true. God gave us his very best gift.
questions: What was your favourite part of the Christmas story?
What gift can you give Jesus today?
prayer: Thank you for coming to be with us.
and I’m so glad you came. Amen.

mission.text: Give someone a hug today and tell them, ‘Jesus came because God loves you!’

en.game: Act out the Christmas story with toys or the nativity set. Then light a candle (with Mom!) and sing ‘Happy Birthday’ to Jesus.

af.title: Kerskampvuur: Veels Geluk, Jesus!
story: Geseënde Kersfees, ontdekker! Vandag vier ons Jesus se verjaarsdag. Onthou jy die belofte wat God in die tuin gemaak het, die leidrade wat Hy vir Jesaja en Miga gegee het, die engel se besoek aan Maria, die lang reis na Betlehem en die baba in die krip? Elke belofte het waar geword. God het vir ons sy heel beste geskenk gegee.
questions: Wat was jou gunstelingdeel van die Kersverhaal?
Watter geskenk kan jy vandag vir Jesus gee?
prayer: Dankie dat U gekom het om by ons te wees.
U is God se beste geskenk,
en ek is so bly U het gekom. Amen.

mission.text: Druk vandag iemand styf vas en sê vir hulle: ‘Jesus het gekom omdat God jou liefhet!’

af.game: Speel die Kersverhaal na met speelgoed of die Kerskrip. Steek dan ’n kers aan (saam met Mamma!) en sing ‘Veels geluk’ vir Jesus.
